Title: Breaking a source table row into multiple rows using materialized views
Description: Is it possible to create two rows in a MV from a single row in a source table?

Insert in source table:
|when | col_1 | col_2|
|-----|-------|------|
|datetime | val_1 | val_2|

I would like to end up with something like this in the Materialized view:
| when | col_x |
|------|-------|
|datetime | val_1|
|datetime | val_2|

Is it possible to do that? Thanks!!
